brand.name: Plainfold

tools.name: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities
tools.summary: Search and monitor U.S. federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov's official daily data extract: RFPs, solicitations, sources sought and award notices.
tools.title: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities: Federal Bids & Awards
does: Returns federal contract opportunities as clean JSON, one row per notice, from SAM.gov's official nightly public extract (not scraped).
Filters by keyword, NAICS, PSC, set-aside (small business, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB), agency, state, posted date and deadline.
Keyword search is relevance-ranked and ignores the FAR/DFARS boilerplate that every defense notice repeats.
Can run on a schedule and return only notices that are new since the last run.
tools.useFor: Finding federal contracts to bid on, daily bid alerts, market research by NAICS/PSC code, and award notices (who won what, for how much).
tools.notFor: State and local bids, non-U.S. tenders, attachment downloads, or historical spending data (use USAspending.gov).
tools.price: $0.002 per opportunity returned + $0.002 per run (about $0.20 per 100 results). No SAM.gov API key needed.
tools.examplePrompt: Find open small-business cybersecurity contracts on SAM.gov with the soonest deadlines.

tools.name: US Business Entity Check
tools.summary: Check whether a US company is registered and active, using official state business-registry open data (New York, Colorado, Oregon, Connecticut, Texas).
tools.title: US Business Entity Check: Verify a Company Is Real & Active
tools.dataSource: State registry open data: NY, CO, OR, CT, TX
does: Give it company names; for each one it returns a verdict (active, inactive, status unclear, not found) and the matching registrations.
Each registration includes legal name, registry ID, entity type, status, good standing, jurisdiction, formation date and business address.
Company records only: it never returns officers, agents, owners or any other personal data.
Handles suffix and punctuation differences (Inc vs Inc., L.L.C. vs LLC) and lists similar names separately.
tools.useFor: Vendor and supplier checks before paying, KYB onboarding, lead qualification, and confirming that a company named in a contract, invoice or email actually exists.
tools.notFor: People lookups, states other than NY/CO/OR/CT/TX, credit or financial data, or a legal certificate of good standing.
tools.price: $0.004 per company found, $0.0005 per lookup with no match, + $0.0005 per run. Failed lookups are not charged.
tools.examplePrompt: Is Arrow Electronics, Inc. a real, active registered company? Which states is it registered in?

tools.name: Company Jobs & Hiring Signals
tools.summary: Give a company website, name or job-board URL and get its open jobs in one clean format plus a hiring summary: roles by department and location, new postings, hiring velocity and growth hints.
tools.title: Company Jobs & Hiring Signals: Open Roles from Any Careers Page
tools.dataSource: Public job-board APIs (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and 6 more)
does: Finds the company's public job board from its website and auto-detects Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Breezy HR, Personio and BambooHR.
Returns every open job in one normalized format: title, department, team, location, remote/hybrid/onsite, seniority, posted date, URL and salary when published.
Adds a hiring summary per company: open roles by department, location, seniority and workplace type, roles posted in the last 7/30/90 days, hiring velocity and plain-language growth hints.
Optional postedSince filter for monitoring new roles. No personal data: no recruiter or hiring-manager names, emails or phone numbers.
tools.useFor: Sales and account research, investment and market research (hiring velocity as a growth signal), recruiting and competitive intel, and monitoring a list of companies for new roles.
tools.notFor: Searching all jobs across the web by keyword (it works company by company), Workday/iCIMS/Taleo-only employers, LinkedIn or Indeed listings, or anything about people.
tools.price: $0.003 per company summary (only when a job board is found) + $0.001 per job returned + $0.0005 per run. Companies with no board found are not charged.
tools.examplePrompt: Is ramp.com hiring right now? Which departments, and how many roles were posted in the last 30 days?

tools.name: SEC Company Financials
tools.summary: Get clean annual and quarterly financials for any SEC filer from official EDGAR XBRL data: revenue, net income, EPS, cash flow, assets, liabilities, cash, shares, margins, YoY growth and TTM, plus company info and latest filings with links.
tools.title: SEC Company Financials: Clean Fundamentals from EDGAR
does: Returns key financials from official SEC filings (EDGAR XBRL): revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, EPS, operating and free cash flow, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, long-term debt and shares.
Covers the latest fiscal years and quarters, with YoY and QoQ growth, margins and trailing twelve months (TTM).
Adds company info (CIK, tickers, exchange, SIC industry, state of incorporation, fiscal year end) and the latest filings with links.
Accepts tickers, CIKs or names; US and foreign SEC filers. No person data: insider and ownership filings are hidden by default and individual filers are refused.
tools.useFor: Answering "how is company X doing?", comparing companies, checking growth and profitability before a sales call, investment research, and citable numbers (every period links to its source filing).
tools.notFor: Stock prices or market data, private companies that don't file with the SEC, analyst estimates, or full line-by-line statements.
tools.price: $0.005 per company returned with financial data + $0.0005 per run. Not-found companies, companies without EDGAR financial data and errors are not charged.
tools.examplePrompt: How did Figma do in its last fiscal year? Revenue, growth, margins and free cash flow, with the source filing.

products.name: Spain Arrival Kit: Your First 90 Days in Spain
products.summary: A calm, step-by-step guide to the NIE, padrón, TIE, bank account, Social Security, autónomo and the Beckham regime, for digital nomad, non-lucrative and student visa holders. 30-page PDF guide plus Notion and Excel trackers, with every rule linked to its official Spanish government source.

includes.details: A 90-day timeline, 10 step-by-step chapters, a document cheat sheet for every step, Spanish phrase scripts and a directory of 40 official sources.
Task tracker, document tracker and dashboard. Imports in one step.
Key dates calculator: enter your arrival date and it works out your TIE deadline, Beckham deadline, padrón renewal and more. Plus task and document trackers.
